)

question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
final_sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth AS ym JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID), min_totals AS (SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total FROM customer_totals GROUP BY Segment), segment_avg AS (SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg FROM customer_totals AS ct JOIN min_totals AS mt ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = mt.min_total GROUP BY ct.Segment), seg_pivot AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS SME_avg, MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS LAM_avg, MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS KAM_avg FROM segment_avg) SELECT SME_avg - LAM_avg AS SME_LAM, LAM_avg - KAM_avg AS LAM_KAM, KAM_avg - SME_avg AS KAM_SME FROM seg_pivot;

question: Paul di Resta was in the No. 853 race, what percent faster did he finish in the 853rd race than the next race for the fastest lap speed?
final_sql: WITH speeds AS (SELECT raceId, CAST(fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) AS fastestLapSpeed FROM results JOIN drivers USING(driverId) WHERE forename = 'Paul' AND surname = 'di Resta' AND raceId IN (853, 854)) SELECT ((MAX(CASE WHEN raceId = 853 THEN fastestLapSpeed END) - MAX(CASE WHEN raceId = 854 THEN fastestLapSpeed END)) * 100.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN raceId = 854 THEN fastestLapSpeed END)) FROM speeds;
